name: briefing_action_queue_add_show_element
description: Briefing_ActionQueue::AddShowElement allocates a show-element action, stores the target element, inserts it into the briefing action queue, and returns the updated node count.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean in briefing_action_queue_add_methods; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because tick bodies and the runtime constructor remain byte-blocked.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x404640 validates allocation of an 8-byte show action, target storage, queue-node insertion after the sentinel, node-count increment, and return of the updated count.
The native briefing objective-action smoke verifies show actions for the expected locator panels in queue execution order.
